# Amit Roy

> Amit Roy is a Kolkata-based UI/UX Designer and Frontend Developer with 5.8+ years of experience building scalable, responsive web interfaces.

## Services

- UI/UX design and Figma-to-frontend implementation

- Responsive UI, component architecture, motion, and interaction design
- CMS and storefront delivery with WordPress, Shopify, and Strapi

## Technology

React, Next.js, Angular, Svelte, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Tailwind CSS, GSAP, Three.js, Figma, WordPress, Shopify, and Strapi.
